Theodore Roosevelt, A Book-Lover’s Holidays in the Open.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/theodore-roosevelt/a-book-lovers-holidays-in-the-open

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Theodore Roosevelt, the author, died 1919.

First publication of the text used: 1916 (SE colophon: 'A Book-Lover’s Holidays in the Open was published in 1916 by Theodore Roosevelt.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the rights statement quoted below places the text in the United States public domain. The text was first published in 1916, before 1931.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.
